about_the_game:
In a decadent realm where magic and mischief rule, players take on the role of rogue alchemists competing in a twilight world known as the Lustrous Realm. Here, you are tasked with seducing, outsmarting, and defeating a lineup of dangerously enchanting anime girls—each a manifestation of a forgotten elemental goddess cursed by vanity and power.

Armed only with a mystical deck of cards, players draw potions to heal, poisons to weaken, weapons to strike, and mana to chain devastating combos. Each target—whether it’s the Crimson Geisha, the Abyssal Bunny Queen, or the Egyption Feline—has unique abilities and tempting tricks to turn the battle in her favor.

Every victory breaks a piece of the curse binding these femme fatales, revealing glimpses of their tragic backstories and granting players access to rare cards and steamy secrets. But be warned: the deeper you go, the more seductive and deadly your targets become.

Will you master the deck and conquer the Lustrous Realm—or fall victim to beauty, deceit, and arcane vengeance?

70 plus cards

Intriguing story with captivating visuals

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains adult content including frequent nudity, sexual dialog, sexual scenes/scenarios, and anime boobies.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 500mb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
